resources.string: What’s new
A few things changed while you were away.
Added
Improved
Fixed
Got it
Eleven new languages, from Vietnamese and Turkish to Hindi, Korean and Traditional Chinese.
Plugins from any source, including skills and MCP servers, installed straight from Plugins.
Live Mode: talk through an idea hands-free and hear the answer read aloud (#77).
Choose when Code auto-compacts, use /autocompact per chat, and watch the new context meter (#81).
Markdown preview in the editor, plus importing many files or a whole folder at once (#74).
Custom or unlimited memory length, and up to 20 keys for each search provider (#75).
Workspace configuration, 96 Learn lessons, saved answers, GitHub pull requests and Retry on another model (#71).
Custom visuals, AH Rumble haptics, tips, and a clear notice when a feature needs a newer Android.
Hugging Face search inside the app, pause and resume for local models, and stronger on-device build tools.
Side questions (/btw), AH Auto steering, and agent-managed settings on Chat and Code (#72).
Chat answers are easier to read, requested links stay visible, and pictures follow your own count and placement.
Settings search lands on the exact control, subagents are easier to follow, and plugin installs show real progress.
Faster startup, smoother high refresh-rate screens, and more polished buttons and animations.
Gemini tools, 9Router npm installs and rich responses that arrive as JSON in directives (#80, #82, #84).
Side questions no longer hide under the keyboard, and empty tool arguments now get a helpful hint (#76, #79).
GitHub import and update checks.
